{{Quote|We learned that Republic forces were finally mobilizing to counterattack the Imperials in the Seswenna sector, but soon afterward, they were painfully defeated and hundreds of Republic soldiers were captured.|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
In [[3680 BBY]], during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''battle''' between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] occurred in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The battle was catalyzed by the Empire's [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[blockade of the Rimma Trade Route]], which had been strangling the flow of Republic military goods from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to embattled regions in the distant Outer Rim. Leaders of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] attempted to stage a counterattack in the Seswenna sector using the [[Republic Army]], but the effort met with defeat. The victorious [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] took hundreds of [[Republic soldier]]s as [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war in the aftermath and continued their domination of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] until later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], when the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] regrouped in the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and launched a second [[Second battle of the Seswenna sector|offensive]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Any opportunity of ending this war quickly has passed. In the weeks since we learned of the attack on Korriban, each day has brought increasingly distressing news.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
[[File:Dural_first_duel_JMGD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sith and Jedi battle on Eliad in the Minos Cluster.]]
When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the two interstellar superpowers sparked the bloody [[Great Galactic War]], which quickly spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and claimed many lives. In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the war, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] struggled to organize effective defense strategies, allowing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and their massive [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|war machine]] to sweep across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], seizing [[Sector/Legends|sector]] after sector. In the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Armada]] quickly secured newly conquered territory and planned a [[Tingel Arm campaign|trap]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], which inevitably arrived in the region to retake its lost holdings. The Republic's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was quickly routed and scattered, throwing defense planning on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] into disarray and allowing the Empire to make further advances in the Outer Rim. At this point, the Sith began targeting the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lane]] that ran from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the Republic to the distant Outer Rim.<ref name="JoMGD" /> At [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along the route,<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Sith [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|destroyed]] the Republic's [[Sluis Van Shipyards|shipyards]] and slaughtered many of the [[Planet/Legends|world's]] defenders. And at great detriment to the Republic, the Empire also [[Minos Cluster Campaign|invaded]] and claimed the resource-rich [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]],<ref name="JoMGD" /> which sat at the tail end of the Rimma Trade Route.<ref name="Atlas" />

To further confound the Republic's defense efforts and claim a stronger hold on the Outer Rim, the Empire positioned elements of its naval armada in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] along the Rimma Trade Route, effectively [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockading]] the lane to prevent the free flow of goods and war materiel. The [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] had a severe effect on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had mobilized quickly in the wake of the Minos Cluster invasion and were now trapped on the battlefronts of the Outer Rim with waning supplies and little hope of reinforcement. For months, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] on [[Eliad]] and other Minos worlds held out against the Imperial onslaught, but were unlikely to repel the invaders while the Rimma Trade Route remained closed.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Their fate remains unknown, but from the Empire's previous treatment of Republic military personnel, we know not to be too optimistic.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
In response to the blockade in [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> leaders of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] devised a counterattack plan to strike against the Imperials in the Seswenna sector. The [[Republic Army]] engaged the Sith in the region, but was decisively defeated; the counterattack ended with no measure of success. During the battle, hundreds of [[Republic soldier]]s were captured by the Empire and taken as [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war, bound in chains and herded into captivity.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Second battle of the Seswenna sector}}
{{Quote|There is yet hope in the Seswenna sector, as we understand that the Republic fleet regrouped and broke up the blockade of the Rimma Trade Route, meaning more resources to support fighting there and for those of us battling here in the Minos Cluster.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
The loss of the battle was a severe failure, particularly to the Republic forces fighting in the Minos Cluster. Reports of the captured Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] brought morale to a low point, as the Empire's treatment of previous prisoners of war indicated there was little hope that the incarcerated [[Troop/Legends|troops]] would be seen again. In spite of the setback, the Republic Navy managed to regroup its fleets and organize a [[Second battle of the Seswenna sector|second attack]] on the Imperial blockade in the Minos Cluster. That effort saw great success, with the Imperial Armada being forced to release the Rimma Trade Route by the end of the engagement.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first battle of the Seswenna sector was introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Canon|lore]] in the [[2011]] [[List of books|book]], [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]. Penned by [[Robert Chestney]] under the persona of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], the book is told through a series of journal entires that document the events of the Great Galactic War. ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'' was included as part of the collectors edition bundle of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the massively-multiplayer online [[Star Wars video games|video game]] for which the book was written to provide background information.<ref name="JoMGD" />
